meta.title: Knockout and Dutch auctions refuse multi-product rounds without fast bidding
gaps: Cannot configure a knockout auction with two line items.
Cannot configure fast bidding off or on.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: Cannot create and publish a second independently configured auction in the same plan.
the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: Cannot create a Dutch auction as a plain price round type.
The setup recipe provides one auction line item, so the multi-product refusal condition is not fully reproduced.
Round 2 successful publication cannot be checked because one plan has exactly one fresh setup record.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and an auction round attached, not published.
steps: As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still a draft (not published).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You are not allowed to perform this action”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still a draft (not published).

plan.title: Knockout and Dutch auctions refuse multi-product rounds without fast bidding

assert.say: the event is still a draft (not published)

expected.message: You are not allowed to perform this action
